hybridoma autoantibodies are a valuable tool for the study of the molecular basis of SLE.

the hybridoma system is a powerful tool for the identification and study of autoantibodies that react with cytoskeletal proteins.
cytoskeletal proteins may be important targets of autoantibodies in SLE.
